de.abas.jfop.base.buffer

Interface BaseReadableBuffer

  • All Superinterfaces:
    Buffer
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    AddBuffer, CharactBarBuffer, DbObjectBuffer, EnvBuffer, GlobalTextBuffer, LoadableBuffer, LoadBuffer, LockableBuffer, ParentScreenBuffer, PrintBuffer, ReadableBuffer, ScreenBuffer, ScreenEnabledBuffer, SelectableBuffer, SelectBarBuffer, SelectBuffer, TableEnabledBuffer, TableModifiableBuffer, TextBuffer, UserTextBuffer, WriteableBuffer

    This interface provides basic read access to a buffer.

    • Method Detail

      • getQualifiedFieldName

        String getQualifiedFieldName(String field)
                      throws FOPException
        Gets the qualified name for a field of this buffer. This method does not check for field existence. It just builds a String "buffer|field".
        Parameters:
        field - The unqualified field name.
        Returns:
        The qualified field name.
        Throws:
        FOPException - If an error occurs.

      • isEmpty

        boolean isEmpty(String field)
         throws FOPException
        Checks if a field is empty.

        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO function used here is F|EMPTY.

        Parameters:
        field - The field name.
        Returns:
        True if the variable is empty.
        Throws:
        FOPException - If an error occurs.

      • isVarDefined

        boolean isVarDefined(String field)
              throws FOPException
        Checks if a field is defined in this buffer.

        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO function used here is F|DEFINED.

        Parameters:
        field - The field name.
        Returns:
        True if the variable is defined otherwise false.
        Throws:
        FOPException - If an error occurs.

      • getFieldType

        String getFieldType(String field)
             throws FOPException
        Gets the ERP type of a field.

        Returns:
        The field type.
        Throws:
        FOPException - If an error occurs.

      • getActualFieldType

        String getActualFieldType(String field)
                   throws FOPException
        Gets the actual ERP type of a field and resolves named types.

        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO functions used here are F|ACTTYPE(F|TYPEOF(...)).

        Parameters:
        field - The field name.
        Returns:
        The field type.
        Throws:
        FOPException - If an error occurs.
